text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly remember that a colleague gave me
a coupon for a haunted house.
Maybe it'll serve as a nice change of pace.
choice_data_list: Since we have the chance, why don't we go check it out?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...A haunted house...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
I would be delighted to accompany you...

text_block_list.name: Eerie Voice
text_block_list.text: (Ooooh...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This is quite a full-fledged facility...!
Just taking a single step tests one's courage..."
choice_data_list: If you get scared, just let me know anytime...!
If you're scared, you can tell me anytime, okay...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much...
However, please do not worry.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "I've always been fine with places like this... Before I even realize it, I often find myself at the exit..."
choice_data_list: Doesn't sound like much fun, does it...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: No need to worry... I am with my Trainer today, after all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I wouldn't normally set foot in such a place
of my own accord... so this is a fine opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If she says so, then it will surely be all right... But there's no telling what horrors await. Bracing myself, I press forward.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I see... So the doll's missing arm
is somewhere in this room...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though my fear couldn't be wiped away at all, there was no telling
what kind of trap might attack her.
Taking the lead, I began searching the room—

text_block_list.name: Western Doll
text_block_list.text:
(HELPMEHELPMEHELPMEHELP
MEHELPMEHELPMEHELPME—!)
choice_data_list: Waaaaah!!?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I-It's alright...
It was just the doll talking, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Um, if you don't mind...
shall I lead the way?
choice_data_list: ...N-No! Leave it to me!
...N-No! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I am her Trainer.
I want to be someone she can rely on, no matter what.
choice_data_list: I'll protect you, no matter what...!
I'll protect you, no matter what...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ! ...Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I made my way down the dim hallway, shielding her as we walked.
What if something jumps out from the shadows...!
choice_data_list: Don't leave my side...!
Don't leave my side...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yes...
...I want to be closer by your side...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: ...Are you scared and nervous?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Hyah...!
U-Um—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...N-No!
Um... Y-Yes... it's just so scary...!
choice_data_list: It's okay, I'm here for you
It's okay, I'm here with you

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Ugh.
Y-Yes... thank you very much..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...So it's already over, then.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Somehow... I feel reluctant to leave.
That time really went by in the blink of an eye.
choice_data_list: I'm glad you had a good time.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I'm surprised at myself, honestly.
To think a haunted house could make my heart race this much...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I didn't feel anything in particular, but...
For some reason, this time—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: What's the matter?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
No, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...Lately,
every single thing I see looks different.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (I can now empathize with the yearnings of novel protagonists that I used to not understand—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(My heart was racing, even in a haunted house
that wouldn't usually faze me at all.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(It's like the world has started to shine brighter than ever before...
The reason the world looks so different is—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Oh.
Is this... an advertisement for an event?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "Tour the World in VR☆Miracle Tour!". Traveling the world in virtual space... I see...
choice_data_list: Interested in traveling the world?
Curious about traveling the world?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
No, the trip itself wasn't quite that...
...It's just—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
When I'm with you, Trainer,
I feel like the whole world shines so brightly.
choice_data_list: Then shall we go check it out together?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ! Are you sure...?
choice_data_list: Because I want to see all kinds of scenery with you.
Because I want to see all kinds of scenery with you.
Next time, I have to make sure not to show such a pathetic side of myself.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ! Are you sure...?
choice_data_list: Because I want to see all kinds of scenery with you.
Because I want to see all kinds of scenery with you.
Next time, I have to make sure not to show such a pathetic side of myself.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, me too.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
No matter what country, no matter where it is,
I will follow you anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Even if it's... at the very ends of the earth.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Is that...
perhaps from the haunted house...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "That is not true at all. Having you by my side... was immensely reassuring."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If you'll protect me, I will...
follow you anywhere.
